original_ai_output.title_zh: 阿布贾Akalaka 009格斗之夜：Ayana与Ezekiel夺冠
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿布贾举办第九届Akalaka“神秘之剑之战”综合格斗与表演拳击赛事，Jackiel Ayana和David Ezekiel分别获胜。Ayana在羽量级主赛中以裸绞降服对手，获得最佳降服、最佳拳手及“神秘之剑”三项荣誉。赛事包含七场MMA比赛和一场拳击表演，主办方称该推广活动自2021年起从尼日尔三角洲地方选手扩展至国际关注。

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾举办Akalaka 009综合格斗与表演拳击赛事
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: an action-packed night of mixed martial arts (MMA) and exhibition boxing in Abuja

key_facts.fact: Jackiel Ayana在羽量级主赛中以裸绞降服Victor Dooga获胜
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ayana, popularly known as the “Smiling Assassin”, submitted Victor Dooga, aka “The Benue Boy”, to win the featherweight main event through a rare naked choke in two minutes, 37 seconds.

key_facts.fact: David Ezekiel以技术击倒击败Joseph James，获最佳击倒奖
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: David Ezekiel, known as “The Badger”, won the Best Knockout Artist of the Night award after defeating Joseph James, aka “The Great Lion”, by technical knockout.

key_facts.fact: 赛事包含七场MMA比赛和一场特别拳击表演
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: featured seven MMA bouts across different weight divisions and a special boxing exhibition
